quote: “And, when you want something, all the universe conspires in helping you to achieve it.”
source: Paulo Coelho, The Alchemist, Part One (Melchizedek, the king of Salem) (trans. Alan R. Clarke, 1993)
speaker: Melchizedek, the king of Salem

evidence.where: Two quotation guides keyed to the HarperOne edition of Alan R. Clarke’s translation give the sentence verbatim with the leading “And,” and page 22 to 24, spoken by the old king (Melchizedek) to Santiago in Part One; the wording matches the Clarke text as I know it
evidence.edition: The Alchemist, trans. Alan R. Clarke, HarperSanFrancisco, 1993 (HarperOne reprints, p. 22)
evidence.locator: Part One, Melchizedek’s first talk with Santiago in the plaza at Tarifa

reason: The line is Melchizedek’s to Santiago in Part One of Clarke’s 1993 translation, verbatim including the opening “And,”; it is the sentence the novel is known by, spoken by a character, so the speaker goes in the source.
